![](https://i.ibb.co/sdwb99Mr/d-aboutus.png)  

> Ghost Express was founded **June 10th, 2020**, by Ghøst with the intentions of creating a community that many people can sit there and call their second home. With years passed, that goal has been achieved with more work and progress being made day by day to continue improving what is provided for over 200+ members. Working along our staff and members to ensure our quality is up to the expectations of everyone within Ghost Express, ranging from our in-house modifications, mini-games, events and more! With all this being said.. 

                     Welcome to **Ghost Express | September Edition '26**! We hope you enjoy your time driving with us.

event_request.rules:
## **Rules for Participants**  
• Only approved Event Staff are able to use the following words or phrases in their player tag; "*Ghost Exp. | CC*", "*Ghost Exp. | Lead*", "*Ghost Exp. | Tail*", "*Ghost Exp. | CCM*", "*Ghost Exp. | CCS*", "*Ghost Exp. | Media*".  
• Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.  
• Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.  
• Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
• Participants must haul a trailer. (*Except Event Staff*)  
• Advertising is prohibited. (*Except Event Staff*)  
• Buses are prohibited.  
• Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.  
• Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers, Heavy Haul or similar configurations are prohibited.  
• Overtaking is prohibited.  
• Free roaming on the server is prohibited.  
• All other [TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

## **Rules for Event & Media Staff**  
• Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
• Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
• Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.  
• Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.  
• All other [TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.
